items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like renewal of the frost-fractured valve: 1 × €52 gross.
Section 7.1.9 covers the connection hose renewed with the fractured valve: 1 × €27 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover the repair labour at the full invoiced quantity: 3 × €98 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(e) and 7.1.9 expressly cover consumables actually used in the fitting repair, rather than general shop supplies: 1 × €10 gross.
Sections 7.1.9 and 7.1.11 cover one plumbing attendance. The same-wording reference supports €41 gross for this first visit, within its €38–€44 range.
Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging equipment used to trace the escape. One use is estimated at €75 gross, below the €2,500 event limit.

items.description: Plumbing vehicle costs for return visit
items.rationale: Section 7.1.11 excludes a second attendance by the same contractor unless agreed in advance, and no approval is stated. If approved, one visit is estimated at €41 gross.

items.description: Removal of loose and spalled facade plaster
items.rationale: The facade frost endorsement is in force, and section 2.6.2 covers stripping failed plaster from the damaged elevation: 2 × €95 gross.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d) cover like-for-like base plaster for the damaged area: 1 × €160 gross.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(c) cover reinstating the damaged substrate: 1 × €185 gross, assuming this is distinct from the base plaster and separately billed painter labour.
Section 2.6.2 expressly covers priming the damaged area before refinishing: 1 × €55 gross.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(c) cover drying where needed before reinstatement. The single billed drying item is estimated at €90 gross if necessary.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d) cover the coats required by the like-for-like finish system. The four coats are included in one billed item, estimated at €220 gross.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(f) cover labour on the damaged elevation: 5 × €78 gross. The undamaged rear repaint is billed separately.

Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.8 cover the one scaffold setup for the roughly eight-metre-wide, two-storey damaged elevation, estimated at €900 gross. No apportionment is needed because the rear was painted from ladders after the scaffold came down.
Sections 2.6.3(a), 7.1.5 and 7.1.6 exclude repainting a separate undamaged elevation, even for appearance matching. The single repaint is estimated at €950 gross only as a conditional price.
Sections 2.6.2 and 5.2.1 cover disposal of plaster removed during the insured repair. One disposal charge for a few rubble sacks is estimated at €75 gross.
Sections 3.6(b) and 7.1.12 exclude a separate administrative fee even when the underlying work is covered. The single fee is priced conditionally at €25 gross.
Section 3.6(a) expressly excludes catering for the contractor's crew. The conditional gross price is 3 × €15, with no indemnity payable.
